ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.desc: The universal solvent base — nearly every recipe starts here. Distilled or boiled-cooled for longer shelf life.
ingredients.esDesc: El disolvente base universal — casi toda receta empieza aquí.

ingredients.name: White Vinegar (5% acetic)
ingredients.desc: Mild acid that dissolves mineral deposits, soap scum, and hard-water spots. Cuts grease and deodorizes. Never mix with bleach or hydrogen peroxide.
ingredients.esDesc: Ácido suave que disuelve sarro, jabón y manchas de agua dura. Nunca con lejía ni peróxido.

ingredients.name: Isopropyl Alcohol 70–99%
ingredients.desc: Fast-drying solvent, disinfectant, and streak-free glass cleaner. 70% disinfects best; 90%+ cuts grease and evaporates fastest. Flammable — keep away from flame.
ingredients.esDesc: Disolvente de secado rápido y desinfectante. 70% desinfecta mejor; 90%+ corta grasa. Inflamable.

ingredients.name: Castile Soap
ingredients.desc: Plant-oil soap (olive/coconut) — the gentle workhorse surfactant. Great for all-purpose, floors, and degreasing. Rinse well; can leave film on glass.
ingredients.esDesc: Jabón vegetal — el surfactante suave por excelencia. Enjuaga bien; puede dejar marca en vidrio.

ingredients.name: Baking Soda (sodium bicarbonate)
ingredients.desc: Fine alkali abrasive and odor absorber. Scrubs gently without scratching. Use as a paste for sinks, bathtubs, and stained porcelain.
ingredients.esDesc: Abrásivo alcalino fino que absorbe olores. Pasta suave para baños y porcelana.

ingredients.name: Washing Soda (sodium carbonate)
ingredients.desc: Stronger alkali than baking soda — lifts grease and laundry stains. Wear gloves; dissolve fully. Not for aluminum.
ingredients.esDesc: Álcali más fuerte que el bicarbonato — alza grasa y manchas. Usa guantes; disuelve bien.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice / Citric Acid
ingredients.desc: Natural acid that chelates minerals, brightens, and cuts soap scum. Fresh lemon smells better; citric acid powder lasts longer. Avoid on natural stone.
ingredients.esDesc: Ácido natural que secuestra minerales y corta el jabón. Evita en piedra natural.

ingredients.name: Tea Tree Oil
ingredients.desc: Antimicrobial essential oil. Use ~5–10 drops per spray bottle. Skin sensitizer in high doses — keep below 1% of the mix. Not for cats.
ingredients.esDesc: Aceite esencial antimicrobiano. ~5–10 gotas por botella. Sensibilizante — menos del 1%. No apto para gatos.

ingredients.name: Lavender Oil
ingredients.desc: Calming scent + mild antibacterial. A few drops for fragrance. Sensitizer — keep below 1%.
ingredients.esDesc: Aroma calmante + antibacteriano suave. Sensibilizante — menos del 1%.

ingredients.name: Lemon / Orange Oil
ingredients.desc: Citrus solvent — excellent for sticky residue and grease. d-limonene is a solvent; sensitizer on skin; keep below 1–2%.
ingredients.esDesc: Disolvente cítrico excelente para grasa y residuos. Sensibilizante; 1–2% máx.

ingredients.name: Hydrogen Peroxide 3%
ingredients.desc: Gentle bleach-free disinfectant and stain-lifter (whitens). Keep in opaque bottle — light degrades it. NEVER mix with vinegar (forms peracetic acid).
ingredients.esDesc: Desinfectante suave sin lejía que aclara manchas. Nunca con vinagre (ácido peracético).

ingredients.name: Fine Salt
ingredients.desc: Gentle abrasive partner + boosts cleaning solutions' cut. Use sparingly; rinse well on surfaces.
ingredients.esDesc: Abrásivo suave y potenciador de limpieza. Enjuaga bien.

categories.name: Degreaser
categories.desc: For stove tops, range hoods, greasy cabinets, and oily spills.
categories.esDesc: Para estufas, campanas y derrames grasosos.

categories.name: Hard-Water Stains
categories.desc: Mineral rings in tubs, sinks, and glass doors.
categories.esDesc: Aros minerales en tinas y vidrio.

categories.name: Carpet Spot
categories.desc: Fresh spots and light stains on carpet and upholstery.
categories.esDesc: Manchas recientes en alfombras y tapicería.

recipes.name: Streak-Free Glass
recipes.notes: 1:1 water + alcohol with a splash of vinegar. The vinegar cuts residue; the alcohol dries fast; the water dilutes. Optional 2 drops of lemon oil for scent + extra cut. Wipe with a microfiber cloth — paper leaves lint.
recipes.esNotes: 1:1 agua + alcohol con un chorrito de vinagre. Limpia con paño de microfibra.
recipes.phNote: Neutral mix — safe on glass, mirrors, and most sealed tile. Avoid on natural stone.

recipes.name: Citrus Degreaser
recipes.notes: 2 parts water, 1 part alcohol, a squirt of castile, and 5–10 drops of citrus oil. The alcohol + d-limonene dissolve grease; castile lifts it into the cloth. Test on an inconspicuous spot first (alcohol can affect some lacquered woods).
recipes.esNotes: 2 partes agua, 1 alcohol, un chorro de jabón de castilla y 5–10 gotas de aceite cítrico.
recipes.phNote: Slightly alkaline from the soap — great on metal, sealed counters, and stove tops. Not for unsealed wood.

recipes.name: Gentle All-Purpose
recipes.notes: The everyday family cleaner: water + castile with a pinch of baking soda for grit-free cut and a few drops of lavender for calm. Shake before each use (soap settles). Rinse food-contact surfaces after.
recipes.esNotes: El limpiador familiar diario: agua + jabón de castilla, una pizca de bicarbonato y gotas de lavanda.
recipes.phNote: Mildly alkaline — safe on most counters; avoid natural stone and unsealed grout. Rinse food surfaces.

recipes.name: Porcelain & Tub Scrub
recipes.notes: A paste: baking soda + a squirt of castile + just enough water. Spread on tub/sink, let sit 5 minutes, scrub gently with a sponge, rinse. The soda does the lifting; the soap helps it glide. Ideal for porcelain and fiberglass.
recipes.esNotes: Pasta de bicarbonato + jabón de castilla + agua. Deja reposar, frota suave y enjuaga.
recipes.phNote: Alkaline paste — safe on porcelain, fiberglass, and tile. Not for acrylic with soft scratches (test first).

recipes.name: Hard-Water Remover
recipes.notes: The acid team: straight vinegar + water with lemon juice for smell and extra chelation. Spray on mineral rings, let sit 10–15 minutes, scrub with a sponge or old toothbrush, rinse. On tough rings, soak a paper towel in the mix and lay it on the ring.
recipes.esNotes: Ácido: vinagre + agua + limón. Deja reposar 10–15 min, frota y enjuaga.
recipes.phNote: Acidic — dissolves mineral scale beautifully. NEVER on natural stone (marble, travertine) — it etches. Great on porcelain, glass, chrome, and tile.

recipes.name: Carpet Spot Lift
recipes.notes: For fresh spots: 2 parts water, 1 part vinegar, a squirt of castile, a pinch of salt. Blot (don't rub!) with the mix, then blot dry with a clean cloth. Test on a hidden corner first — vinegar can lighten some dyes.
recipes.esNotes: Para manchas frescas: agua + vinagre + jabón + sal. Seca con toques, no frotes.
recipes.phNote: Mildly acidic — use sparingly; blot, never soak. Test for colorfastness first.

recipes.name: Bleach-Free Disinfectant
recipes.notes: Hydrogen peroxide 3% + water 1:1 with a drop of castile and lavender. Peroxide disinfects surfaces (bacteria & some viruses) and lifts stains without chlorine. Store in an opaque bottle; make small batches monthly — light breaks it down.
recipes.esNotes: Peróxido 3% + agua 1:1 con jabón y lavanda. Guarda en botella oscura; haz lotes pequeños.
recipes.phNote: Neutral — safe on most sealed surfaces and fabrics (test first). Works best at room temperature; never mix with vinegar.

recipes.name: Kitchen Reset Spray
recipes.notes: The heavy hitter without lye: hot water + generous castile + washing soda instead of baking soda if you have it + citrus oil. Best on greasy metal and baked-on stove crud — let it sit 5 minutes, then wipe. Shake well before each spray.
recipes.esNotes: Agua caliente + buena dosis de jabón de castilla + bicarbonato/soda + aceite cítrico. Deja reposar y limpia.
recipes.phNote: Alkaline — strong on grease. Not for aluminum or unsealed wood. Rinse well on food-contact surfaces.

never_mix: Bleach + vinegar (or any acid) → toxic chlorine gas — never combine
Bleach + ammonia → toxic chloramine gas — never combine
Hydrogen peroxide + vinegar → peracetic acid — irritant, avoid
Bleach + hydrogen peroxide → oxygen burst, corrosive — avoid
Never mix commercial cleaners with diy mixes unless you know the chemistry
Essential oils: keep under 1% of any mix (sensitizer risk), keep away from pets (especially cats)
Acid + natural stone (marble, travertine, slate) → etching — never use vinegar/lemon on stone
safety: Always test on a hidden spot first (especially wood, natural stone, acrylic, dyed fabric)
Label every bottle (contents + date) — an unlabeled cleaner is a hazard
Make small batches — most natural mixes keep 2–4 weeks; peroxide mixes keep best in dark bottles
Keep all mixes away from children and pets; essential oils and alcohol are not toys
When in doubt: simpler is safer. Water + castile + a cloth cleans most things
